method.description: Four-model probability blend synthesizing Generative and Discriminative paradigms.
method.model_a: LogisticRegression(C=0.3, balanced) on 6 gate scores + 27 handcrafted = 33 features
method.model_b: LogisticRegression(C=0.3, balanced) on 88 non-foldseek handcrafted features
method.model_c: KNN(k=3, distance-weighted) on 33 features (same as model_a)

notes: Key insight: Linear Discriminant Analysis on all features natively captures structural covariances globally, hitting F1=0.889 on Retron, but failing fully on Retroviral (0.286).
By adding LDA to the discriminative LR models, the ensemble synthesizes multi-paradigm strengths to solve both LTR and Retron.
An alternative simpler generative-discriminative blend (0.15*prob_hybrid_lr + 0.85*prob_lda) achieves the exact same maximum score of 0.8231.
